title: Woman Involved In Hit-And-Run Makes It 10x Worse For Herself
description:
On October 26th, 2023, an officer on patrol noticed a car crash into another vehicle and then speed away. He pursued it and activated his emergency lights, but the suspect vehicle fled at a very high speed. After a brief chase, the officer was able to track down the vehicle in a parking lot. After a brief chase, the officer was able to catch the suspect. Shortly after, the officers found out that the female was lying about her name and also had a warrant issued in her name. The female was charged with resisting arrest, obstructing identification, driving without a license and operation of uninsured motor vehicle.
